verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own materials claim multi-agent teamwork: automatic team formation that assembles the right agents for a task, agent teams that deliver complex work together, multiple agents sharing context on Pages, and a showcase of a 'CAO' dispatching 50 agents to work 500 issues in parallel. These are marketing-level claims only, with no detailed documentation of how orchestration, delegation or parallel execution works. Missing for 10: technical docs on subagent/swarm orchestration mechanics, any agent-to-agent protocol support, documented parallel task splitting and result aggregation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
